smoothzoom.options.title: Smooth Zoom
smoothzoom.options.amount.tooltip: How much the view is magnified while the zoom key is held.
smoothzoom.options.speed.tooltip: How quickly the zoom eases in and out. Higher is snappier.
smoothzoom.options.look.tooltip: While zoomed, moving the mouse builds up speed gradually and glides to a stop instead of following instantly. Stronger the more you zoom in. Off follows the mouse directly.
smoothzoom.options.scroll.tooltip: While the zoom key is held, the mouse wheel changes the magnification instead of the hotbar slot.
